title: HB 2428 (2013-2014 Regular Session (2014)): Kansas protection against voter suppression act. (index); AN ACT concerning elections; enacting the Kansas protection against voter suppression act; amending the crime of perjury; amending K.S.A. 2013 Supp. 21-5903 and 25-2309 and repealing the existing sections.

(d_proof_of_citizenship)
(section) K.S.A. 25-2309(m)(14) (new document type: signed affidavit)
(quote) (14) a signed affidavit swearing under oath the following: "I am a United States citizen. I meet the eligibility requirements of my state and subscribe to any oath required. The information I have provided is true to the best of my knowledge under penalty of perjury. If I have provided false information, I may be fined, imprisoned or (if not a U.S. citizen) deported from or refused entry to the United States."
(e_other_rule)
(section) New section: short title
(quote) (a) This section shall be known and may be cited as the "Kansas protection against voter suppression act"
(other) K.S.A. 21-5903 (perjury): adds subscribing the registration affidavit under penalty of perjury.
(other) K.S.A. 25-2309: adds a signed citizenship affidavit as one accepted document for registration.
